questions.q: What is lag time on a storm hydrograph?
options: Time between peak rainfall and peak discharge
Time between the start of rain and the end of rain
Time the river stays in flood
questions.why: Lag time is the delay from peak rainfall to peak discharge.

questions.q: Which of these is an example of soft engineering?
questions.why: Flood plain zoning works with nature by restricting building on flood-prone land.

questions.q: Why does urbanisation shorten lag time?
options: Impermeable surfaces and drains speed runoff to the river
questions.why: Tarmac and drains reduce infiltration and carry water quickly into the river.

questions.q: Explain one advantage and one disadvantage of hard engineering to control river flooding.
questions.model: Advantage: structures such as embankments or dams give strong protection to towns. Disadvantage: they are expensive and can increase flood risk downstream or harm habitats.
points: advantage, e.g. strong/effective protection for a town
disadvantage, e.g. expensive or floods downstream / damages habitats
